title: Lamb with peas, spring onions and mint

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Everything is whole food (potatoes, lamb mince, peas, spring onions, Greek yoghurt, lemon, mint, cumin, olive oil), with nothing factory-made.

supermarket.reason: All items are everyday supermarket lines, and peas in the pod are stocked in June.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a roasting tray and a small bowl, and the technique is simple roasting and stirring.

works.reason: The potatoes get 35 minutes at 220°C, the crumbled mince about 20, and 1.2kg of pods yields roughly 450g of peas, which together make a sensible meal for four.

honest_times.reason: The cook time of 15+12+8 minutes matches the printed 35, and podding the peas while the tray roasts plus slicing and mixing fits within about 20 active minutes.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning is used in the steps, and nothing unlisted appears.

seasonal_feel.reason: Freshly podded June peas with mint and new potatoes are the centre of a warm early-summer traybake.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, clear British English with no restaurant language or preaching.

hearty_healthy.reason: Lamb, potatoes, plenty of peas and yoghurt make a balanced, satisfying family dinner.
